# Algorithmic Information Retrieval Center

> Information Gain Modeling, Novelty Scoring, and Knowledge Graph Grounding

## Published Research Monographs
- [Information Gain Algorithms and Entity Graph Grounding in Generative Search Runtimes](information-gain-algorithms-entity-graph-grounding.html): An analytical exploration of how algorithmic search engines score content novelty, evaluate Schema.org entity hierarchies, and reward verified factual consensus.
- [Patent Analysis: Algorithmic Information Gain Scoring](patent-analysis-information-gain-scoring.html): Deconstructing USPTO information gain patents and content novelty metrics.
- [Entity Disambiguation via Microdata Hierarchies](entity-disambiguation-microdata-hierarchies.html): Structuring JSON-LD graphs to establish verified topical authority.
